symptom: `describe page` printed a Data grid 2 as `datagrid dg (DataSource: database from Shop.Ord, PageSize: 25, Pagination: virtualScrolling)` although exec had stored `configurationStorageType: localStorage`, `itemSelectionMethod: rowClick`, `refreshInterval: 30`, `columnsHidable: false`, a column's `minWidth`, labels and the empty-state placeholder (mendixlabs/mxcli#1573). Executing the description wrote the widget's default over every one of them, with `check` and `mx check` at 0 errors; a Studio Pro-authored grid lost its `onClickTrigger: double` the same way. The Gallery had the same loss (pagination, pageSize, showEmptyPlaceholder, state storage).
cause: The write side takes any pluggable-widget setting by its own property key (the explicit-key pass), but the describer for the widgets it has dedicated extractors for (datagrid2, gallery, combobox, filters) read only the properties MDL has a keyword for. The generic pluggable path that does print by key (extractExplicitProperties) is skipped for those widget types (isKnownCustomWidgetType), and it has no notion of a default, so it could not simply be switched on: it would print the whole schema of every untouched widget.
fix: cmd_pages_describe_bykey.go: nonDefaultPropsByKey reads each property's declared type and default from the stored widget's own Type.ObjectType (and the item type of `columns`) and prints a setting only when it differs from what exec writes for it left out; wired into the datagrid2 and gallery describers, each column, and the emptyPlaceholder slot. Text templates compare against the text the widget ships (Translations), an Expression prints unquoted (quoted when it is only a string literal), an attribute prints bare only where exec resolves a bare name; a value with no MDL spelling (attribute over associations) is named in a `-- NOT re-executable` comment.
test: mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_bykey_test.go (against the shipped Data grid 2 / Gallery templates); mdl-examples/bug-tests/1573-datagrid-by-key-settings-describe.mdl
insight: Three traps decided the design. (1) DefaultValue is not the default exec writes: four text templates have DefaultValue '' but store their shipped text from Translations, so comparing with DefaultValue printed four labels on every grid; the untouched-grid test is built from the shipped widget template for that reason. (2) `describe -> exec` printing 'Unchanged page' proves nothing about the writer: exec keeps the stored page when the statement equals its description, so a lossy describer is a fixed point of itself; the round trip only shows after `drop page` + exec of the description, compared as BSON with ids stripped (v0.27.0 differs on all six pages of the bug-test script, the fix is identical on all six). (3) A by-key `itemSelection: Single` is stored as PrimitiveValue with Selection 'None' (the explicit pass routes a Selection-typed key as a primitive: mappedKeys holds mapping Sources, not keys), i.e. no selection at all, so the bug-test uses `Selection:`; describe skips Selection-typed keys, which keeps a describe -> exec -> BSON comparison from hiding that write-side defect.
